observed.caption: Two colorful buses stopped on a busy urban street with pedestrians crossing and tall buildings in the background.
observed.description: A green and yellow bus with an advertisement on its side is stopped in the foreground on a paved street, with a blue and yellow bus behind it to the right and a third bus further in the background. Multiple pedestrians are visible on the sidewalk and crossing the street, including a person in a high-visibility vest seated on a motorcycle near a traffic light pole. Tall buildings with many windows, leafy trees, utility poles with cameras, and a large yellow billboard are visible in the background under overcast daylight. A large rock sits on a small traffic island near the curb.
